scripts.test:rules:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-daily-fresh-rules-test --config emulator/firebase.financial.local.json --only firestore "node --test emulator/rules.staged.test.mjs"
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build && npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:android: npm run cap:sync && powershell -Command "$env:JAVA_HOME = 'C:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr'; $env:ANDROID_HOME = '$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Android\Sdk'; .\android\gradlew.bat -p android assembleDebug"
scripts.build:android:release: npm run cap:sync && powershell -Command "$env:JAVA_HOME = 'C:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr'; $env:ANDROID_HOME = '$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Android\Sdk'; .\android\gradlew.bat -p android assembleRelease; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path release; Copy-Item 'android\app\build\outputs\apk\release\DailyFresh.apk' -Destination 'release\DailyFresh.apk' -Force"
